text:
sara: Quick heads-up — onboarding OrbitOS LoRA adapter (cust: Orbit). Ran an int4 smoke on dedicated staging and saw a clear hallucination uptick on instruction-follow tasks. Putting a short summary here.

mila: saw the same. Ran a compare vs fp16 baseline. Pass rate on our instruction-qa suite dropped from 92% -> 74% for the int4 build. Will paste failing examples.

jay: can you paste the eval command & top failing examples?

sara: eval command:
```
python eval/run.py --suite instruction-qa --model orbit-lora-int4 --baseline orbit-lora-fp16 --batch 8 --seed 42
```
Top failing example:
Prompt: "List the steps to reset a router's admin password"
FP16: "Go to router admin > System > Password > Reset; follow prompts."
INT4: "To reset, contact ISP support or buy replacement hardware."

kevin: that's suspicious — factual collapse, not tokenization. Any differences in tokenizer or remap? Also did we enable kv-prefix-cache for the int4 runtime?

mila: tokenizer is identical. KV cache = enabled on the int4 staging worker group. I disabled KV cache for one quick run — throughput dropped but behaviour improved on that sample. Running a broader test now.

deploy-bot: deploy 4850001235 to staging-int4-group by @sara — config: kv_cache=true, attn_kernel=fastmix

kevin: propose next steps:
- re-run smoke with kv_cache disabled
- run a focused hallucination eval pack (50 prompts) & collect token-level logits + attention maps
- if still problematic, try int8-hybrid quant or fallback to fp16 for this customer
Assign: @mila run the kv_cache=false smoke, @jay collect logs (token logits + attention maps).

mila: on it, kicking off the job now. I'll post diffs and a short example set in ~30m.

sara: thanks. If kv cache is the culprit we should add a temporary config flag for Orbit customers and an immediate canary that routes 10% traffic to fp16 fallback until we root cause.

jay: quick script to extract logits I used:
```
python tools/dump_logits.py --run 4850001234 --out /tmp/orbit/logs
```

mila: update — after disabling kv cache, pass rate improved to 88%, and the clear hallucinations disappeared on 45/50 prompts. A few edge cases remain, digging into those.

kevin: looks like prefix KV caching interacts badly with the int4 kernel selection for this adapter. Filing issue ML-893 and adding a note to onboarding checklist to run kv_cache sanity on quant builds.

sara: filing + looping in customer success to prep rollback/communication plan. cc @kevin @mila

mila: filed: https://redwood-internal/issue/ML-893 with reproducer, logs, and sample prompts.

jay: attaching attention maps and token logits to the issue now.

sara: cool — we'll keep updates here. :thumbsup:
